maria (eng-security): we got a DSAR from EU user requesting deletion of embeddings + backups. they attached ID.
jon (privacy): ok i'll validate identity. which S3 prefix and kms?
maria (eng-security): s3://redwood-embeddings/eu/cust-5678/ encrypted with kms:alias/rdw-eu-emb. nightly snapshots replicate to us-west-2.
lee (eng-platform): replication uses region-specific CMKs. deletion must remove live objects, instruct replica agent, and revoke grants; do NOT schedule CMK deletion.
sara (legal): check for legal hold. if none and ID verified, legal ok to proceed.
jon (privacy): identity validated. what's the erase play?
maria (eng-security): proposed: create ephemeral dsar-runner role (scoped S3/KMS perms), mark snapshots "erasure_in_progress", delete live prefix, call regional agent to delete replicas, revoke grants, bundle audit package (object keys + sha256, KMS key ids, op logs) and redact unrelated PII.
lee (eng-platform): RBAC: privacy should not get direct S3/KMS access. create privacy.erase_trigger role that issues workflow tokens which invoke the dsar-run job. two-person approval required.
ops-bot: runbook/dsar/erase-v1 started by maria
maria (eng-security): running now. commands (internal):
aws s3 rm s3://redwood-embeddings/eu/cust-5678/ --recursive --region eu-west-1
curl -X POST https://internal/snapshot/mark -d '{"snapshot_id":"snap-20250510-5678","status":"erasure_in_progress"}'
jon (privacy): include grant revocation traces and workflow token id in audit bundle.
maria (eng-security): will do. two-person approval granted.
ops-bot: approval recorded. job queued.
maria (eng-security): update: live objects removed at 4511112299. replica delete queued for us-west-2.
lee (eng-platform): replica purge in progress; replication lag 5m.
maria (eng-security): final: replicas removed, grants revoked, audit package uploaded to evidence vault (evidence-id: ev-4511112222). sending receipt to requester.
jon (privacy): received. closing ticket.
sara (legal): reviewed receipt; no retention exception. closing.
